Court Booking Rules

  • The full Rules are on the Brentham Club tennis website, so please read them there. https://www.brenthamtennis.co.uk/guide-to-court-usage. This text is only a summary of the main points.
  • Members can book Tiger Turf (TT), clay and grass courts 4 days prior from 7.15 am. In other words, when booking to play 4 days in advance the new booking sheet only becomes available from 7.15 am -- all other playing times within 4 days can be booked 24/7.
  • Tennis coaches have priority on booking Tennis Court 12, however, members may also book this court from 7.15 am on the day of play subject to availability.
  • Members MUST select their playing partner / opponent's name to show on the booking sheets as soon as possible after making the booking.
  • Members who were under 11 yrs when they joined, can only play a max of 1 hr in any day, plus play in any group coaching session they have paid for. There are other restrictions for these juniors, as described in the full rules.
  • Maximum booking 1.5 hrs per day for all other members when booking 1 day or more in advance. Members can also play within another member's booking. Subject to availability an additional 1 hr per member can be booked on the same day playing.
  • Children under 13 yrs must be supervised by a guardian or a qualified coach, for safeguarding reasons, but parents can only play with their children if they are members, subject to the guest rule below.
  • Cancellations:
    • When unable to play, members should cancel their booking(s) as soon as possible so that other members may use the court.
    • Cancellations made within 24 hours are logged as "late-cancellations".
  • Visitors / Guest Fees ( only allowed for members over 11 yrs)
    • Any individual visitor may only play once during any calendar month. Any visitor who wishes to play more frequently must join the Tennis Section of The Brentham Club.
    • When playing a Guest, members must select "Guest Â£3 per 30 mins" as the playing partner/opponent to show on the booking sheets for each of the 30-minute sessions playing with the guest.
    • The system will automatically charge the Guest Fee to your booking system account.
    • If you're no longer playing a Guest, you can change your playing partner/opponent to a member, and the Guest Fee will be returned.
    • This can be done when you book the court or any time before playing.
    • You will then need to top-up your Booking System account (click link to Buy Credit) in order to cover the guest fee charges before booking more courts.
